settings.tab_content: Fermented in conical stainless steel tanks for 14 days under pressure, maintaining precise temperature control to limit ester production.
Double dry-hopped with 18g/L of Citra and Mosaic lupulin pellets during active fermentation for bio-transformation notes.
Store upright at 4°C/39°F. Serve chilled in a clean tulip glass to release aromatic hop terpenes.
Shipped in double-walled insulated boxes with reusable cold packs. Guaranteed cold from brewhouse to doorstep.
